slug: 2025-10-23 Congo relaunches NIU biometric unique-ID card production

COG.note: No electronic authentication service is described.
No link between the civil register and the NIU is stated.
No count or share of people enrolled is given.
The NIU is issued from age 6, not at birth registration.

facts.fact: The Finance Ministry relaunched production of the NIU card from September 2025, with biometric capture in physical presence, per the ministry's own article.

The NIU began as a mandatory taxpayer registration for the DGID (Décret 2004-469) and Order 25550 (Oct 2022) makes it mandatory for tax and customs declarations and social-security registration, per the Finance Ministry.
The Finance Ministry says the NIU is issued to every foreign resident and Congolese citizen from age 6, valid 10 years, free for individuals.
The NIU modernised in 2020 (order 5327) captures iris and fingerprints in physical presence, and Minister Christian Yoka frames it as curbing duplicates and fraud.
